findings.title: Root backup/restore follow a symlinked ~hermes/.hermes
findings.detail: Layout.hermes_names() lists os.listdir(hermes_home) and item_root('hermes:<name>') = hermes_home/name; the move-aside, mkdir(parents=True) and O_NOFOLLOW open protect only the last component. ossbot-hermes.service has ReadWritePaths=/home/hermes, so the hermes uid can replace .hermes with a symlink. Confirmed by a hermetic probe: restore wrote the archive's Hermes files (evil.service, SOUL.md, config.yaml, memories/, skills/, state.db; owner hermes) into the symlink target and would move same-named files there aside; a backup with .hermes -> the secrets dir recorded hermes:gatekeeper.env in an archive marked includes_secrets false. Code execution as hermes thus becomes root writes (e.g. /etc/<name>) at the owner's next restore. Fix: refuse in backup and restore when the Hermes home (or any item root, also artifacts/<cid>, imports/<cid>, chat) is a symlink, resolves elsewhere, or is not a directory of the expected owner; re-check after Hermes is stopped; add unit tests for both directions.

findings.title: Backup's paused-only resume restarts the workers stopped by a workers /down
findings.detail: _backup_pause pauses whenever ossbot is neither paused nor killed, including during a workers-scope down. ossbot-resume --paused-only removes 'paused', exits early only while killed, and otherwise runs start_unit for gatekeeper, proxy, dockerfilter, sandboxd, runner, Hermes and the probe socket, which starts every enabled inactive unit. The weekly timer can therefore silently bring runner, Hermes and sandboxd back while the lifecycle flag still says down, contrary to DESIGN 13.5. Fix: in --paused-only mode start nothing (a pause stops no unit), or skip the worker units while a lifecycle flag exists; add a test (backup during a workers down).

findings.title: Restore keeps going after its kill or unit stop failed
findings.detail: ossctl restore records kill_exit and stop_failed, then decrypts, moves the state aside and installs regardless. A gatekeeper that did not stop keeps serving the moved-aside DB while finalize_db writes killed/dry_run=1 into the new one; a kill that wrote no flag leaves the DB killed without the flag the workers and the Docker filter read (reconcile alert loop). Fail closed: refuse (nothing moved, the units restarted in killed mode) unless the killed flag exists and stop_failed is empty; add a unit test with a failing helper/systemctl.

findings.title: Hermes crash-safety case can SKIP while the suite passes
findings.detail: test_crash_safety.sh skips the Hermes mid-relay case when no chat turn starts (relay closed), yet the AC requires the case to pass. Fail when the relay should be open (tier and probe OK), or fail the run when this case was skipped.

findings.title: Lifecycle helper checks the request, then reads it by path
findings.detail: The -L/-f check and the stat/head reads in ossbot-lifecycle are separate path lookups in a gatekeeper-writable directory (only a compromised gatekeeper could race them). Rename the request into a root-only dir first (rename does not follow symlinks), then check and read the moved inode; this also makes 'always consumed' atomic.

findings.title: Format file count in VERIFICATION
findings.detail: The FEAT-008 close-out row says ruff format checked 350 files; DEV ruff format --check src tests reports 342 at HEAD. Correct the number.
